items.label: spent fuel
items.quote: High-level waste is primarily spent fuel removed from reactors after producing electricity.

items.label: fission products
items.quote: These isotopes, called "fission products," account for most of the heat and penetrating radiation in high-level waste.

items.label: cesium-137
items.quote: The fission creates radioactive isotopes of lighter elements such as cesium-137 and strontium-90.

items.label: plutonium
items.quote: These atoms form heavier elements such as plutonium.

items.label: reactor operations
items.quote: Low-level waste comes from reactor operations and from medical, academic, industrial, and other commercial uses of radioactive materials.

items.label: protective shoe covers
items.quote: contaminated protective shoe covers and clothing, wiping rags, mops, filters

items.label: wiping rags
items.quote: protective shoe covers and clothing, wiping rags, mops, filters, reactor water treatment residues
